description: llama.cpp optimized for NVIDIA Tesla V100 (SM70): Qwen3.8-Flash-Next with MTP (prefill 3402 tok/s at 200K context on 6x V100-16GB; also runs on 2x V100-16GB) and Qwen3.8-27B with DFlash2 (decode up to 220 tok/s); 2-6 GPUs, 262K-512K context, multimodal, concurrent serving, built-in web UI.
summary: llama.cpp optimized for NVIDIA Tesla V100 (Volta, SM70): 2–6 GPU tensor parallelism, Qwen3.8-27B Q8_0/Q4 with DFlash2 speculative decoding, up to 512K context, multimodal (image/PDF/video) and concurrent serving.
